Home About Log in Get started ↗
GET TO KNOW CHIRPR

A little thought.
A bigger connection.

The best parts of the internet start with people. A passing thought, a shared interest, a conversation that goes somewhere unexpected. That’s the feeling we want to build Chirpr around.

Be part of it → Explore the idea ↓
✦ Small thoughts. Big connections.
THE IDEA BEHIND CHIRPR

Social media should
feel social again.

Some of the most meaningful connections begin with something small: a question, a joke, a moment you wanted to share.

Chirpr is being designed as a place for those moments. A familiar way to post, connect, and explore — with a little more personality and a little less noise.

↗ Built around people, not just posts.
